positions.name: KestrelwoodErasureDirective
positions.frame: what should be removed from the record concerning the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration?
positions.why: src-1 and src-2 are both imperative directives aimed at the same target — the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration — with src-2 specifying the scope src-1 names generally (instrument, frequency, and the person who did the work). Both carry decision-level conviction, authority-ranking stance, and activated-negative, pressure-register delivery: a single performed command that escalates from a general instruction to an enumerated one. src-3, though adjacent in subject, sits at a lower conviction register (claim vs. decision) and is a distinct speech act (assertive vs. directive) supplying a justification rather than extending the command itself, so it is read separately rather than folded into this group.
